areas.title: Section 3: Gmail API technical architecture
improvements: Token encryption uses AES-256-GCM with authenticated encryption and PBKDF2-SHA256 key derivation (stronger than spec's AES-256) via crypto.ts:6-98
Token refresh with automatic database persistence via oauth2Client.on('tokens') callback (client.ts:69-128)
InvalidTokenError custom exception for graceful revoked token handling (client.ts:7-12)
Rate limit handling with exponential backoff (2^n * 1000ms + random jitter) and 3 retries (client.ts:240-252)
Automatic token refresh attempt in createGmailClient before API calls (client.ts:144-160)

areas.title: Section 6: Database schema for subscription tracking
improvements: CASCADE deletion on all 8 user-related relations for GDPR Article 17 right to erasure (spec only REFERENCES without cascade) via schema.prisma:44(Account),55(Session),83(Subscription),100-101(SubscriptionPreference),117(GmailSyncState),136(RollupSettings),150-151(UnsubscriptionAttempt),167(BulkDeletionJob)

7 additional indexes for query performance beyond spec: Subscription(userId,lastSeenAt), SubscriptionPreference(userId), GmailSyncState(userId), RollupSettings(userId), UnsubscriptionAttempt(userId,subscriptionId), UnsubscriptionAttempt(status), BulkDeletionJob(userId,status)
Nullable rollupFrequency in SubscriptionPreference (sensible: keep/unsubscribe actions don't need frequency)
Prisma@relation with onDelete Cascade enables automatic cleanup for account deletion endpoint

Additional bulk-delete queue for mass deletion operations beyond spec's 3 queues (queues.ts:51-57)
